meta.name: alterlab-deeptools
meta.description: Process and visualize deep-sequencing coverage with the deepTools CLI — convert BAM to bigWig (bamCoverage), build log2 ratio tracks (bamCompare), run QC (multiBamSummary correlation, PCA, plotFingerprint), apply the ATAC-seq Tn5 shift (alignmentSieve --ATACshift), and make TSS/peak heatmaps and profiles (computeMatrix, plotHeatmap, plotProfile). Use for coverage tracks, signal heatmaps/profiles, normalization (RPGC/CPM/RPKM), and effective-genome-size lookups for ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, MNase-seq, or RNA-seq. NOT for per-read/CIGAR/MAPQ BAM record access — that is pysam. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 处理并可视化深度测序覆盖度数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做ChIP-seq、ATAC-seq等测序数据的覆盖度分析和可视化
copy.tagline_en: Process and visualize deep-sequencing coverage data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you analyze coverage and signal tracks for ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, or RNA-seq

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能处理和分析高通量测序数据，例如将 BAM 文件转为 bigWig 覆盖度轨道、进行质量控制（如指纹图、相关性分析）、生成热图和谱图，以及执行 ATAC-seq 的 Tn5 偏移校正。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 BAM、bigWig 或 BED 文件，或提出“转换 BAM 到 bigWig”、“检查 ChIP 质量”、“创建热图”、“比较样本”等任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我将 ChIP-seq 的 BAM 文件转为 bigWig 覆盖度轨道。
对这两个 ChIP-seq 样本做质量控制分析。
在 TSS 区域生成 ChIP 信号的热图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process and analyze high-throughput sequencing data, such as converting BAM to bigWig coverage tracks, performing quality control (e.g., fingerprint, correlation), generating heatmaps and profiles, and applying ATAC-seq Tn5 shift correction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests processing of BAM, bigWig, or BED files, or tasks like 'convert BAM to bigWig', 'check ChIP quality', 'create heatmap', 'compare samples', etc.

say_en.text: Convert my ChIP-seq BAM file to a bigWig coverage track.
say_en.note: Claude will use bamCoverage to generate a normalized bigWig file.

say_en.text: Run quality control on these two ChIP-seq samples.
say_en.note: Claude will perform multiBamSummary, correlation, PCA, and fingerprint QC steps.

say_en.text: Generate a heatmap of ChIP signal around TSS regions.
say_en.note: Claude will use computeMatrix and plotHeatmap to create the heatmap.
